item.title: Thunderstorm Advisory No. 5 #SLPRSD
item.description:
Thunderstorm Advisory No. 5 #SLPRSD
Issued at 06:45 PM 04 September 2026

Moderate to occasionally heavy rainshowers with lightning and strong winds are expected over #Masbate(Balud, Mandaon, Placer), #Romblon(Banton, Concepcion, Corcuera, Calatrava, SanAndres, SanAgustin, Romblon), #OrientalMindoro(Bansud, Gloria, Pinamalayan, Pola and Socorro) within the next 1 to 2 hours.

The above conditions are being experienced in #Masbate(Milagros and Cawayan) which may persist within 1 to 2 hours and may affect nearby areas.

All are advised to take precautionary measures against the impacts associated with these hazards which include flash floods and landslides.

Keep monitoring for updates.
